summary: Frontend-only verification of expanded STAFF (employee) role for order management in Shree Dental Lab. All 22 assertions across staff, admin (regression) and dentist (regression) flows PASSED with zero failures. Backend permission boundaries were pre-verified by main agent via curl; this run focused on UI role-based rendering plus four happy-path staff actions (update-status, generate-invoice, assign-designer, mark-dispatched) and Team edit-email + permission-checkbox removal.
critical_code_review_comments: OrderDetail.jsx is ~520 lines with multiple sub-components (StatusUpdater, AssignDesigner, DispatchBlock, DeleteOrderBlock, ShipImpressionCard, RemakeButton). Consider splitting into /pages/order-detail/ folder for maintainability (file size guideline >700 not yet hit but trending).
Layout.jsx NAV object: 'employee' nav lacks Dashboard (intentional per spec). Confirmed correct; staff lands on /app/orders directly after login.
Users.jsx save() still strips email on create flow (line 44) – minor: f.email is not trimmed on create, only on edit. Low priority.

OrderDetail isStaff = ['admin','employee','designer'] makes designers see Manage Card (StatusUpdater). Backend gate must enforce this for designer; if not desired, gate Manage card behind canManage instead of isStaff (currently designer sees StatusUpdater control even though only admin/employee should). Confirm intent.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded orders; modified one order's status/invoice/designer/dispatch fields via staff happy-path actions (toasts confirmed 'Status updated', 'Invoice generated', 'Designer assigned', 'Dispatched').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Staff role expansion verified end-to-end on frontend. Login button is NOT type='submit' — use page.get_by_role('button', name='Login') not button[type=submit]. Backend curl checks already done by main agent (file-upload 403, delete-order 403 for employee). The StatusUpdater is gated by isStaff (admin|employee|designer) — designer also gets it; verify if that's intended. Admin password did not force-change in this iteration.
